steps.text: From the rooftop, dozens of stories high, the cars and people on the ground are like specks of dust.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: We've strengthened security around your home, Miss Nyamu. Until the situation is under control, please refrain from going out if at all possible.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: With the kidnapper still at large, the agency prefers you scale back your activities for the time being out of safety concerns.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Scale back my activities...?

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Just temporarily. We're sifting through new prospective partners to ensure your absolute safety.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: But my fans...

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Miss Nyamu, you are now one of Lungmen's biggest stars. You need to recognize your own popularity a bit more.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: But...!

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Use this time to get some well-deserved rest, or do something you enjoy.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: —Just stay put.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: I'm going to hang up now. The L.G.D. wants to talk with us again.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Stay put, stay home, huh...?
Nyamu looks around her home—
If it could even be called one.
The massive TV in the living room, which only ever has one viewer.
Someone comes to make the bed every day. It never looks anything but factory new.
Suddenly, something catches her eye.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Found you...
Perhaps it was not that she had forgotten them; perhaps she just did not want to look for them.
At some point, she chose to abandon them of her own accord.
A set of drumsticks, lying in a corner of the bookshelf.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: (Tapping drumsticks together) ...One, two, three, four.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: ...Wow, that was awful.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: You let her go.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: You defied my orders.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I broke the terms of our contract this time. Here is the penalty fee.
Umiri pulls out a bag of gold coins, and places it on the table in front of her boss.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: ...You're rejecting me.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I think it would be best if we stayed hirer and contractor.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I work better as a lone agent. If I want a partner, I have my bass.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: No. You want to go back to Francis and his people.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I've had quite a longstanding interest in their musical parties. Sorry, but I won't be taking a seat at your bigger-stakes table.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Hahahaha... When did I ever say you'd have a seat?

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: You've only ever been a chip.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: And a chip not in the hand is worth nothing.
With those words, the door slams open, and Umiri finds herself surrounded by multiple burly brawlers.
Umiri turns back to look at the boss, and is greeted by the glinting end of a barrel.
The island is about to disappear into the distance.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: What's wrong? You've been staring at the island this whole time.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: I thought I heard someone calling to me...

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: Haha! Must be hearing things. Nothing in these waters except the sound of waves and fowl.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: (Glances) Lotta luggage there. Headed to the city to strike it rich?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: ...I'm looking for someone.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: Ain't that the damnedest thing. You're not the first one to say that...

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: (Loudly) These waves are getting rough...
Above them, darkness has started to creep into the sky.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Boatman
steps.text: (Even louder) Watch out... grab... railing...
But it is too late.
A wave crashes down on the deck, and sends seawater flooding into the cabins.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Wrong... wrong... wrong!

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: This guitar sounds... wrong.
But she knows why full well. A classical guitar could never make the sound of an electric.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Father
steps.text: (Quietly) It's awful late, Mutsumi-chan. Won't you get some sleep?

steps.name: Mutsumi's Father
steps.text: (Quietly) Look, at least just unlock the door...

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: (Quietly) We'll sit by your side and tell you bedtime stories, just like old times.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Not unless you tell me... where Saki went.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Well, we don't know either...

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Maybe she went off and found her own happiness, somewhere else?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: ...You're lying.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Saki's not like that.
There is no response from outside the door.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Saki won't change so easily. She wants me to return to Ave{@nbs}Mujica—

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: You mustn't change so easily either, Mutsumi-chan.
Somehow, Mutsumi's mother is standing behind her.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: This isn't just your dream. It's ours too.

steps.name: Mutsumis
steps.text: We are all Mutsumi.

steps.name: Mutsumis
steps.text: This is our dream, together. Where we can all truly exist, where we all find happiness.

steps.name: Mutsumis
steps.text: Mutsumi-chan, you don't need Sakiko. You only need us.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Mutsumis
steps.text: Let's be—together—forever—and ever—okay?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: No—!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Ten minutes left...

steps.name: Children
steps.text: Bye, Miss Iris! Bye, Miss Bena—

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Bye-bye, bye now!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: You be good children, just like you promised!

steps.name: Children
steps.text: We will—

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Iris, Bena, all set? In that case, let's—

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Miss Sakiko...?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I thought you wouldn't come...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Iris... the necklace...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: N-Necklace?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: In your left pocket—the necklace in the little box that keeps the nightmares away!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: What are you talking about, Miss Sakiko? I don't... what?
Iris reflexively reaches into her pocket, and is surprised to indeed find something in there.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Sakiko... you don't actually have precognition, do you?
Center stage. Mutsumi lies in a pool of blood.

steps.name: Mother
steps.text: My child! Oh, my child!

steps.name: Mother
steps.text: Help her! Somebody!

steps.name: Director
steps.text: What's wrong? Is she hurt?

steps.name: Female Lead
steps.text: Poor girl! She's dead! How horrible!

steps.name: Male Lead
steps.text: It's all a trick! She's not dead. How could she be dead?

steps.name: Other Actors
steps.text: (Noisy chirping)

steps.name: Other Actors
steps.text: (Excited chirping)
Cut!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: ...You're an abysmal actor, Wolff.

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: Sorry. Acting's not my forte.

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Merry laughter)

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Oh, and you think YOU were any better?!

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Panicked crying)

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: This won't do. I'm still short of actors... I need one more...
Morpheus stares daggers at the center of the stage. There, a blue-haired girl sits, eyes closed, but brow furrowed as ever in struggle.

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Dismayed chirping)

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: It's a Siracusan play. Caused quite the controversy, in its opening run.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: True and false, false and true, why does everyone tie themselves in knots over which is which?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Human beings have too strong a need to know everything down to the core.

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: Perhaps, it's the very thing that makes them human.

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: I'm sorry. I spoke out of line again.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: No... Wolff. You're fluent now.

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: Maybe it's all the rehearsals lately... Then again, maybe it's not the rehearsals, but the things I've been seeing. The sort of things that grow a heart a size or two.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Can a woven creation have a 'heart'?

steps.name: Wolff
steps.text: The books tell of a metal man who gained one. Perhaps I can too.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Tut. Shouldn't have let you read so much... I liked your stuttering better.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: She has no 'heart' anymore?!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I can patch her back up, but without a heart, she'll never leave this place again...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: You decide... decide Morpheus's fate.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: (Oh, Iris... oh, Bena...)

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Alas. It would be better if you didn't talk.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: If only, if only, everyone was like me...
Morpheus. It's time we ended this farce of yours.
Upon the stage, where a doll slumbered, now a doll stands.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: What? Excuse me? How?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: This isn't right! No, how could you—

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I made myself clear. I will not be leaving my companions until I have awoken them.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Well, I'll give you two choices—

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: One! Get out of my sight, right now.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Two! I trap you under layers and layers and LAYERS of dreams, and you stay lost in Limbo forever.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I decline.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: You think you can—?!
Sakiko reaches into her pocket.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: (Yes. It's still there.)
Iris's necklace has accompanied her through layer after layer of dreams, and it has followed her here.
Now, she will save Ave{@nbs}Mujica. She will save everyone.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Our bet is still on.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: In their dreams, I saw their innermost thoughts.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Even as their wishes came true one by one, they found no happiness in it.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: They are no hypocrites for it. They are simply still in doubt.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: As the founder of Ave{@nbs}Mujica, I pledged to them that I would take responsibility for their lives.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: From the moment I uttered those words, our fates became inseparable...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: My role is to show the path to lost dolls. I will lead them through the fog, for I must.
Center stage, Sakiko Togawa stands. She casts her eye over her slumbering companions, then returns her gaze to Morpheus.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: They, and you... are no more than lost dolls.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: In the moonlight, the doll takes on a temporal life.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Awaken—

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Stop her!

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Terrifying roar)

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: This is our dream. Therefore, we are its Master.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: We will become as we want to be!

spans.text: become as we want to be!

steps.text: Sakiko Togawa slowly raises a hand, and her clothing begins to transform.
She recalls the Originium Arts she learned in her dream; the songs she wanted to write.
As she has practiced countless times before, she casts down a firm finger—
Upon a white piano key.
The note rings clear in every corner on and off the stage, and bids the threads holding up each doll fall slack.
No longer puppeted, they fall to the expanse of the stage one by one.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Be assured that in the face of all your efforts, I can hardly rest on my own laurels.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Despite all our hardships, we came back together and put on a masquerade that belonged to us, didn't we?

spans.text: Despite all our hardships, we came back together and put on a masquerade that belonged to

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I want to write a song—

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: About our struggles, and the possibilities of the future.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: We are a band. Our destinies are one.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: This is my answer.

steps.name: Mutsumis
steps.text: Put down the guitar, Mutsumi-chan.

steps.name: Mutsumis
steps.text: You're our princess. We'll be by your side, whatever you do.

steps.name: Mutsumis
steps.text: —Cover her ears!

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: (Hugs guitar tightly)

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: You're not me...

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: I miss Saki...

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Somebody, help...
Honestly, what do I do with you?
The 'Mutsumis' throwing themselves at Mutsumi suddenly crash to the ground one by one, as if marionettes whose strings were cut.
I'm on your side, Mutsumi-chan. I'll listen to your deepest desire.
The fully-armed brawlers are closing in on Umiri.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Time we put an end to this, Umiri...

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: What? What's this song...?
AAAAAAAAAARGH!!!

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Umiriiiii!

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: Francis...?! Where did you just drop in from?!

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Sakiko told us all about it! We're all just figments of your dream, ain't we?

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: Why would you go and believe her nonsense...

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: No! Don't you see, everything makes sense now!

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: We trusted you unconditionally because you made us!

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Now that I've accepted it, I feel so light, so free. Umiri, I could do ANYTHING right now!

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: There isn't much time! You've gotta get outta this nightmare!

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: But how am I going to...?

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: It's your dream! You've gotta know!

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: But once I leave, you're all going to...

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: When'd you start getting so hung up on crap?

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Don't you worry! Me and my brothers, we'll think of you when we hold our parties!

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: ...Got it!

steps.name: Francis
steps.text: Go!

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Don't let her get away—!
Umiri grabs her bass guitar case by the handle, bends her knees and lowers her center of gravity—

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I'm—outta here!

steps.name: Francis & Brothers
steps.text: Umiri, our sister! Buon viaggio!

steps.name: Assistant
steps.text: Miss Nyamu...!
A song that none of them have ever heard is blaring at maximum volume.
Yet there is nobody in the room.

steps.name: Assistant
steps.text: Call the security firm!

steps.name: Flustered Guard
steps.text: S-She started streaming!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Good morn-nyamu-nyamu, everyone! Nyamuchi here~!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Your girl's soaring through the skies of Lungmen right now! Haha, and I've got a LOT of patrol cars behind me in hot pursuit!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Whoooo! Feeling good!! Now this is one way to remember Nyamuchi the rest of your lives, huh?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: And if you do get to hold onto any memories, remember one thing—

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Nyamuchi is the drummer of Ave{@nbs}Mujica—Amoris!

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: (My memories... they're fading, piece by piece...)

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: (The last trace I had of her... it's being erased...)

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: (That song... that song...)

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: (A song of the soul...)

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: (I say... you're mine... you're mine...)

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: (Look... you're so close, yet still...)

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: (Light...)

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: (You're like light...)

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: (You always had the power to make people gather around you, basking in your light and warmth...)

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: (That's who you are... Saki-chan.)
Performing, shouting your heart out, again and again, never to stop.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...I apologize.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I apologize, for the countless times I've hurt you all.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: But here and now, I want to see you more than anyone—I want to see you as you really are.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: The destinies of Ave{@nbs}Mujica are one. I bear the weight of your lives on my shoulders, and so I will stake my life to protect you.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I beg you... all of you, wake up.
Midnight. The twin moons hang high in the night sky. Now is the hour of the dolls' awakening.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Let us commence the world of Ave{@nbs}Mujica anew.
